description: Adds a product or a service the business sells that its site or shop does not list, as the owner tells it (Brand › Business › What you offer, as Add a product or service does there), or changes one added this way: the same name again changes that one. Give its name, its price in the owner's words, its page, what it is, and for a product its pictures (file ids from get_upload_link, or none yet). It joins what Marsell makes product pictures and posts from, Sell's offers, and what every plan, post and claim check may state, in the owner's words. One the site or the shop already lists is refused: a correction about it, such as its price, is owner_fact_set. If the site or the shop later lists it, theirs is the one Marsell uses, its price too, and a correction is owner_fact_set as for any product they list. Only what the owner said or a source shows, never a guess. Free: it reads, rates and makes nothing. offering_remove takes one out.

name.description: its name, as the business writes it; the same name as one the owner added changes that one

page.description: its own page, where people buy or book it

picture_file_ids.description: for a product: its pictures already sent (get_upload_link's file ids)

price.description: as the owner writes it: "$25", "from 49 EUR a month"

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

what.description: what it is and who it's for, in a line or two

name: offering_add
title: Add a product or service
